name: Bothe Napa Valley SP
description: Bothe-Napa Valley State Park, between St. Helena and Calistoga on Highway 29, offers camping, picnicking, a seasonal swimming pool, and more than 10 miles of trails through redwood, Douglas-fir, tanoak, and madrone forests.
fullDescription: Bothe-Napa Valley State Park, between St. Helena and Calistoga on Highway 29, offers camping, picnicking, a seasonal swimming pool, and more than 10 miles of trails through redwood, Douglas-fir, tanoak, and madrone forests.
whatTheyOffer:
- Tent, group, and hike-and-bike campsites, plus cabins and yurts (reserve at ReserveCalifornia.com)
- Over 10 miles of hiking trails
- Seasonal swimming pool (summer weekends, 1-5 pm)
- Large picnic grounds and a group picnic area; visitor center and Pioneer Cemetery
- Dogs allowed on leash in camp and picnic areas only (not on trails or at the pool)
- Open daily 8 am to sunset; phone (707) 942-4575
howToGetIt:
**Fees:**
- Day use: $10 per vehicle
- Pool: $5 entry (paid at the park entrance)
- Camping fees vary by site type; see ReserveCalifornia.com

**Save with park passes:** Bothe-Napa Valley accepts the California Explorer, Golden Poppy, Disabled Discount, Distinguished Veteran, Golden Bear, and Senior Golden Bear passes, plus the California State Library Parks Pass (free to check out at public libraries).
